Two functions and the diffusivity constant are retained verbatim, with a reduced
import preamble. All other solver code is omitted; see provenance.json.
The independent sine oracle, web interface and receipt wrapper are SZL additions.

No biomedical literature, third-party database records, patient data, or
project-authored upstream data/docs are bundled. Upstream data/docs use CC-BY-4.0
with separate third-party carve-outs; that is not a blanket license for papers.
